question: Total value of final goods and services produced _______ domestic territory during an accounting year is domestic income.
solution:
The correct answer is __**within.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__ Key Points__** 

 
• The term **"domestic territory"** refers to the** geographical area within a country's borders.**
 
• The total value of final goods and services produced within the domestic territory is known as Gross Domestic Product (GDP).
 
• Domestic income refers to the income earned by individuals and businesses within the domestic territory.
